description: Shared definitions for the CMS: the field vocabulary a content type is built from, a slice instance, and a strong reference. A content model here is DATA — these defs describe the model, not any one document's values.

fieldDef.description: One field in a content type or a slice variation. `type` is the field kind; the other properties are that kind's options. A group nests its own fields, so a type is a tree.

tab.description: Editor tab the field appears under (Prismic 'Main', 'SEO & Metadata').

repeat.description: group: the value is a list of field sets, not one.

single.description: richText: the one block kind allowed (e.g. heading1).

select.description: link: what may be linked — document, media, web, or any.

customtypes.description: link: content-type keys a document link may point at.

allowedSections.description: slices: the slice keys this zone allows. A KNOWN slice outside the list fails validation; an unknown sectionType always passes (the round-trip rule).

maxDepth.description: slices: how deep nested zones may go, bounded by the validator's MAX_SECTION_DEPTH.

sectionEntry.description: A slice instance in a document's body: which slice, which variation, and the values. `primary` and `items` are validated against the slice model, so the lexicon leaves them open.

strongRef.description: A stable reference to a record: its at-uri and the cid it was read at.
